scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev:agent" "npm run dev -w @office/web"
scripts.dev:agent: cd apps/agent && uv run uvicorn office.api:create_app --factory --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3001 --timeout-graceful-shutdown 2
scripts.test: npm run test:agent && python3 -m unittest discover -s apps/device/tests
scripts.test:procurement: uv run --project apps/agent --group dev python -m unittest discover -s apps/procurement/tests -v
scripts.test:agent: cd apps/agent && OFFICE_MODEL=mock TAVILY_API_KEY= uv run --group dev pytest -q
